signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story colonial-style house frontage in autumn; the house is partly obscured by foreground trees but the facade, garage, driveway and lawn are visible.
signals.notes: Two-story colonial with an attached two-car garage and asphalt driveway; the lawn is covered with fallen autumn leaves, and a white vehicle may be parked far right behind the shrubs but is not clearly in the driveway.
